content.text: Immunotherapy: nivolumab plus ipilimumab is typically preferred; nivolumab plus relatlimab (LAG-3) is an alternative with better tolerability; a PD-1 inhibitor alone is also an option. Neoadjuvant PD-1 inhibitors are recommended for selected patients
BRAF-mutant, symptomatic or rapidly progressive disease: BRAF plus MEK inhibitors (dabrafenib/trametinib, encorafenib/binimetinib, vemurafenib/cobimetinib) may be preferred for faster response
T-VEC (intralesional oncolytic herpesvirus) may be considered for unresectable metastatic melanoma; cytotoxic chemotherapy hasn't improved survival and is kept for patients with no other options

meta.title: Systemic therapy for advanced skin cancer (Hedgehog inhibitors, PD-1 inhibitors, cetuximab, BRAF/MEK inhibitors)
